The program was rejected because the word "input" appears in its comments. I removed those words. I also raised the PMOS load length from 0.5 to 0.6 µm for more DC gain margin.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Checker flagged the token 'input' in comments; removed it. Raised PMOS load L from 0.5 to 0.6 for DC gain margin above 36 dB. Topology and budget unchanged: 210 uA tail gives about 105 MHz UGBW, about 95 V/us slew and about 1.0 V swing."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 10.0, 18.0),     # diff pair efficiency
    "L1":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),       # diff pair L (speed)
    "Id1":   (105e-6, 70e-6, 180e-6),# per-side current
    "gmidp": (8.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "Lp":    (0.6, 0.3, 1.0),        # PMOS mirror L (gain vs mirror pole)
    "gmidc": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # NMOS cascode gm/Id
    "Lc":    (0.3, 0.15, 0.8),       # NMOS cascode L
    "gmidt": (11.0, 7.0, 14.0),      # tail / reference mirror gm/Id
    "Lt":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),        # tail L
    "vmarg": (0.22, 0.12, 0.40),     # Vds headroom of the pair beyond its source
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    vdd = 1.8
    Id1 = p["Id1"]
    Itail = 2 * Id1

    # tail and reference mirror (same L and gm/Id)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], Itail, vds=0.25)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=mt.vgs)

    # diff pair, resized with body effect
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Id1, vds=p["vmarg"], vsb=0.2)
    vs = vcm - m1.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Id1, vds=p["vmarg"], vsb=max(vs, 0.0))
    vs = vcm - m1.vgs
    vd1 = vs + p["vmarg"]

    # PMOS mirror load
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Id1, vds=0.6)
    vd_diode = vdd - mp.vgs

    # NMOS cascodes
    mc = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], p["Lc"], Id1,
                  vds=max(vd_diode - vd1, 0.2), vsb=vd1)
    vcas = vd1 + mc.vgs

    # cascode gate bias = Vgs(mb) + iref*R
    R = max((vcas - mb.vgs) / iref, 100.0)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.R("Rb", "ibias", "nb", R)
    n.dev("Mb", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("Mt", "s", "nb", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "a1", "vinp", "s", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "a2", "vinn", "s", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("Mc1", "d1", "ibias", "a1", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("Mc2", "vout", "ibias", "a2", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", mp)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    rcas = (mc.gm + mc.gmbs) / mc.gds / m1.gds
    gout = mp.gds + 1.0 / rcas
    A0 = gm1 / gout
    cpar = mp.cdd + mc.cdd + mc.cgd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * (cl + cpar))
    cmir = 2 * mp.cgg + mc.cdd + mp.cdd
    fp_m = mp.gm / (2 * PI * cmir)
    fp_c = mc.gm / (2 * PI * (mc.cgg + m1.cdd + 1e-15))
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp_m)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * fp_m))) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp_c))
    slew = Itail / (cl + cpar)
    vlow = vd1 + mc.vdsat + 0.05
    vhigh = vdd - mp.vdsat - 0.05
    swing = vhigh - vlow
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "psrr_db": db(A0) - 3, "swing": swing,
               "power": vdd * (Itail + iref)}
```
